name: markdown-checkbox
description: Create and toggle checkboxes in Markdown. xQx fork of PKief/vscode-extension-markdown-checkbox.

scripts.version: npm run changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build && tsc -p ./ && ncp src/test/workspace out/test/workspace

markdown-checkbox.languages.description: The language identifiers for which this extension is activated.

markdown-checkbox.withBulletPoint.description: Create a bullet point before the created checkbox.

markdown-checkbox.strikeThroughWhenCheck.description: Strike through the line of the checkbox after checked.

markdown-checkbox.italicWhenChecked.description: Italic font style of line of the checkbox after the checkbox has been checked.

markdown-checkbox.dateWhenChecked.description: Add date behind the checkbox item after the checkbox has been checked.

markdown-checkbox.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the amount of selected checkboxes in the status bar.

markdown-checkbox.dateFormat.markdownDescription: Date format for `dateWhenChecked`, using moment-style tokens: `YYYY`/`YY`, `MMMM`/`MMM`/`MM`/`M`, `DD`/`Do`/`D`, `dddd`/`ddd`, `HH`/`H`/`hh`/`h`, `mm`/`m`, `ss`/`s`, `A`/`a`. Wrap literal text in `[...]`. Examples: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `DD/MM/YYYY`, `ddd, MMM D HH:mm`.

markdown-checkbox.dateTemplate.markdownDescription: The date template `{date}` is replaced by the actual date.

markdown-checkbox.quickPickEscBehavior.description: Behavior when pressing Esc in the QuickPick panel. 'doNothing' preserves current state, 'uncheckAll' unchecks all checkboxes.

markdown-checkbox.continueChecklists.description: Continue lists (checkboxes, -/*/+ bullets and numbered lists). Pressing Enter on a list item with text creates a new item on the next line at the same indent. On a line with only an empty list marker, Tab/Shift+Tab indent or de-indent it, and Enter removes one level of indent (or, if already un-indented, removes the marker and moves to the next line).

markdown-checkbox.dedupePasteMarkers.description: When the cursor is parked directly after a bare list marker (e.g. '- ' or '- [ ] '), strip a duplicate leading marker from pasted text so the markers don't stack up.

markdown-checkbox.tableCellNavigation.description: Inside a Markdown table, Tab / Shift+Tab move to the next / previous cell (adding a new row when tabbing past the last cell) and reformat the table. Outside a table, Tab / Shift+Tab keep their list-indent behavior.

markdown-checkbox.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: How to handle a newer build found on a `#markdown-checkbox.updateFeeds#`. `auto`: download, install and offer a reload. `prompt`: ask first. `off`: only the **Markdown Checkbox: Check for Updates** command checks.

markdown-checkbox.updateFeeds.markdownDescription: Locations of a `latest.json` release manifest, tried in order (first hit wins). Each entry is an `http(s)` URL or a local/synced folder path.

markdown-checkbox.updateCheckIntervalHou.markdownDescription: Minimum hours between automatic update checks. `0` checks on every activation. The **Check for Updates** command ignores this.
